si_presets.empty: No presets yet. While the list is empty, no picker appears on the stream info page.
si_presets.full: More than %{count} presets are no longer findable in the picker.
si_presets.lead: Saved stream titles. They appear above the title field on the stream info page.
si_presets.name: Stream info – presets
si_presets.perm.edit: may maintain the saved stream titles.
si_presets.rule_double: Two identical rows become one. In the picker they would be indistinguishable.
si_presets.rule_empty: Empty rows are dropped – that is also how you remove a preset without using the button.
si_presets.rule_length: Longer than %{count} characters is truncated; that is Twitch's limit.
si_presets.rule_order: The order stays as you set it here – put what you use often at the top.
